notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 84-year-old female admitted for upper GI bleed. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.65, creatinine 0.84, hemoglobin 13.1, platelets 250, sodium 139, wbc 5.5; vitals dbp 66-70, heart_rate 84-87, map 89-92, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 133-139, spo2 97-98, temp 36.5-36.7
Day 0 orders/meds/results: EGD: mild nonbleeding gastritis; Pantoprazole 80 mg IV
Assessment and plan: Upper GI bleed. Acute blood loss anemia.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.85, hemoglobin 13, platelets 258, sodium 139, wbc 5.7; vitals dbp 66-71, heart_rate 82-87, map 89-93, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 135-138, spo2 97-99, temp 36.5-36.6
Assessment and plan: Upper GI bleed. Acute blood loss anemia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 84-year-old female, length of stay 2 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Upper GI bleed. Acute blood loss anemia. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
